Scanner, tester and bulk tools

Free Barcode Generator

Free barcode generator and bulk barcode generator for India. Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, Code 39. Download PNG or SVG, or a ZIP for a whole list. No signup.

Free Bulk QR Code Generator

Free bulk QR code generator for India. Paste or upload a list of links or text and download all QR codes as PNG or SVG in one ZIP. Up to 1000 codes, no signup.

Free QR Code Scanner Online

Free online QR code scanner for India. Scan a QR from an image, screenshot or camera, including UPI codes, and see the payee and amount before you pay. Private, no signup.

Free QR Code Tester

Free QR code test tool. Check your QR code scans when small, blurry or low contrast, and see what it contains. Private, no signup, no upload.
